---
title: "Metabolite associations with incident diseases and all-cause mortality"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
  echo: true
---

## Setup

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(broom)
  library(survival)
})

disease_dir <- "data/diseases"
metabolome_path <- "data/metabolome.tsv"
white_id_path <- "data/white_british_ids.txt"
covariate_path <- "data/covariates.tsv"
mortality_path <- "data/all_cause_mortality.tsv"
result_dir <- "results/05_metabolite_disease"
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

case_frequency_cutoff <- 0.001

quote_name <- function(x) {
  paste0("`", gsub("`", "", x, fixed = TRUE), "`")
}
```

## Inputs

```{r}
metabolome_df <- readr::read_tsv(metabolome_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(eid = as.character(IID))

white_ids <- readr::read_lines(white_id_path)

covariate_df <- readr::read_tsv(covariate_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(eid = as.character(IID))

metabolites <- setdiff(names(metabolome_df), c("FID", "IID", "eid"))
covariates <- intersect(
  c("Sex", "Age", "Fasting", "Month", "Center"),
  names(covariate_df)
)
eligible_ids <- intersect(metabolome_df$eid, white_ids)
```

## Incident-disease selection

```{r}
read_disease <- function(path) {
  disease_raw <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  if (all(c("eid", "status", "years") %in% names(disease_raw))) {
    disease_raw |>
      transmute(
        eid = as.character(eid),
        status = as.numeric(status),
        years = as.numeric(years)
      )
  } else {
    disease_raw |>
      transmute(
        eid = as.character(eid),
        status = as.numeric(target_y),
        years = as.numeric(BL2Target_yrs)
      )
  }
}

disease_files <- list.files(
  disease_dir,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

disease_summary <- map_dfr(disease_files, function(path) {
  disease_df <- read_disease(path) |>
    filter(eid %in% eligible_ids, years >= 0) |>
    drop_na(status, years)

  tibble(
    disease = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path)),
    path = path,
    total_n = nrow(disease_df),
    case_n = sum(disease_df$status == 1),
    control_n = sum(disease_df$status == 0),
    case_freq = case_n / total_n
  )
})

selected_diseases <- disease_summary |>
  filter(case_freq > case_frequency_cutoff)

readr::write_csv(
  selected_diseases,
  file.path(result_dir, "selected_incident_diseases.csv")
)
```

## Metabolite-disease Cox models

```{r}
fit_metabolite_cox <- function(disease_name, disease_path, metabolite) {
  disease_df <- read_disease(disease_path) |>
    filter(eid %in% eligible_ids, years >= 0)

  model_df <- disease_df |>
    inner_join(covariate_df, by = "eid") |>
    inner_join(
      metabolome_df |> select(eid, all_of(metabolite)),
      by = "eid"
    ) |>
    drop_na(status, years, all_of(covariates), all_of(metabolite)) |>
    mutate(across(any_of(c("Month", "Center")), as.factor))

  model_formula <- reformulate(
    c(covariates, quote_name(metabolite)),
    response = "survival::Surv(years, status)"
  )
  model_fit <- survival::coxph(model_formula, data = model_df)

  broom::tidy(model_fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(stringr::str_remove_all(term, "`") == metabolite) |>
    transmute(
      disease = disease_name,
      metabolite = metabolite,
      HR = estimate,
      HR_lower = conf.low,
      HR_upper = conf.high,
      p.value,
      n = nobs(model_fit),
      events = sum(model_df$status == 1)
    )
}

metabolite_disease_results <- pmap_dfr(
  selected_diseases |> select(disease, path),
  function(disease, path) {
    map_dfr(
      metabolites,
      ~ fit_metabolite_cox(disease, path, .x)
    )
  }
)

readr::write_tsv(
  metabolite_disease_results,
  file.path(result_dir, "metabolite_incident_disease.tsv")
)
```

## All-cause mortality

```{r}
mortality_df <- readr::read_tsv(mortality_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  transmute(
    eid = as.character(IID),
    status = as.numeric(ACM_event_indicator),
    time = as.numeric(ACM_survival_time)
  ) |>
  filter(eid %in% eligible_ids, time >= 0)

metabolite_mortality_results <- map_dfr(metabolites, function(metabolite) {
  model_df <- mortality_df |>
    inner_join(covariate_df, by = "eid") |>
    inner_join(
      metabolome_df |> select(eid, all_of(metabolite)),
      by = "eid"
    ) |>
    drop_na(status, time, all_of(covariates), all_of(metabolite)) |>
    mutate(across(any_of(c("Month", "Center")), as.factor))

  model_fit <- coxph(
    reformulate(
      c(covariates, quote_name(metabolite)),
      response = "survival::Surv(time, status)"
    ),
    data = model_df
  )

  broom::tidy(model_fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(stringr::str_remove_all(term, "`") == metabolite) |>
    transmute(
      outcome = "all_cause_mortality",
      metabolite = metabolite,
      HR = estimate,
      HR_lower = conf.low,
      HR_upper = conf.high,
      p.value,
      n = nobs(model_fit),
      events = sum(model_df$status == 1)
    )
})

readr::write_tsv(
  metabolite_mortality_results,
  file.path(result_dir, "metabolite_all_cause_mortality.tsv")
)
```
